nonHousing.derivation: Goods and other-services shares from a least-squares fit of ln(all items) on the four published components across the BEA metros; BEA does not publish area expenditure weights.
nonHousing.formula: exp(wGoods*ln(goods) + wOther*ln(other)); utilities and housing excluded
nonHousing.whyUtilitiesExcluded: ACS gross rent already includes utilities paid by the renter.

method.rent: ACS median gross rent (contract rent plus renter-paid utilities and fuels). Values published only as a bound (open-ended interval) or without an estimate are left out (null).
